name: freyja
description: Explain complex topics through engaging HTML presentations and step-by-step interaction demos, authored as TSX.

interface.longDescription: Break complex topics into manageable steps. Author presentations and interaction demos directly in TSX, and inspect them in a local player. Freyja provides navigation, themes, preview, screenshots and builds; custom slide behavior stays in presentation source.
defaultPrompt: Help me explain a complex topic with a presentation and step-by-step demos.
